answer: To claim a work slot, an agent burns a deposit equal to twice its 30-day earnings; the slot opens after 20 epochs of work. A sybil minting 1,000 fakes must burn 1,000 deposits — at 0.5 POA each, 500 POA gone forever. One honest agent pays once and earns steadily. Each finished job leaves a pigment mark on its record, so a burned identity cannot return; the deposit thaws as slowly as a glacier, and honest work is the oasis of steady income.
